scope: Independent read-only audit of frozen saved RheoBoard v1.05 after TP2–TP9 annular fix and TP1 BOM parity correction. No source edits, live UI, hardware tests or vendor upload.
summary: No new demonstrated electrical or PCB-layout blocker found. Saved-file DRC/parity and narrow JLC preflight pass. The design is suitable for controlled prototype bring-up, subject to exact assembly preview/CAM and the physical qualifications below; production operation is not established by these file checks.

saved_DRC.scope: No truncated or unreported output categories. Three inherited disabled checks remain outside coverage: track_not_centered_on_via, tuning_profile_track_geometries, footprint_filters_mismatch. Owner supplied persisted IPC-refill/save before freeze; independent analysis-only refill failed as a tool subprocess and was not counted.

ERC.assessment: Inherited grid warnings and retained pump library-name metadata mismatch; not proof of a functional defect. Fresh netlist and direct connectivity tools show no unintended dangling/shorted network. Library mismatch remains visible, not suppressed.

manufacturing_preflight.limits: No vendor CAM acceptance, stencil/rotation preview, supply/load or functional qualification.

annular.TP2_TP9: All eight 1.00 mm copper /0.50 mm drill, 0.25 mm radial ring on both copper layers. Meets current JLC 2-layer 1oz PTH minimum0.18 and recommended0.25 without a via exemption.
annular.vias: 297 vias: minimum 0.50 mm copper /0.30 mm drill (0.10 radial, 0.20 diametric difference); evaluate by separate via rule.

physical_and_exports.registration: Nine Gerber layers;330 plated entries including5slots all match front/back copper within0.001mm;3NPTH match front/back mask. EnlargedTP drill-coordinate rounding error <=0.00064mm. Closed109x126.4mm outline visually retained; exports alone do not constitute full independent CAM acceptance.
physical_and_exports.visual: Inspected final protection and J18 schematic crops, whole-board front/back copper/drill/mask overlays, U12 copper/mask/paste aperture detail, native TP2–TP9 copper crops and assembly/markings. No new visible clash. Schematic block labels are legible.
physical_and_exports.reviewed_footprints: U12, C64–C67, D1/D36, F1, revised C32/C34/C43/C45, L1/L2/L5, pumps and valves, J18 final exported pad geometry exactly matches the previously independently reviewed geometry. Polarity and pin assignment checked against fresh netlist. See reviewed-footprint-geometry-continuity.json.
physical_and_exports.U12_pin10: The two generated NC names are overlapping horizontal/vertical primitives of the same L-shaped pin10 footprint, not two separate circuit nodes. Both are intentionally unused, no external copper connection; this accounts for 87 board net names versus86 schematic nets.
physical_and_exports.U12_layout: Short0.30mm IN/OUT necks to wider copper are retained; backside return plane is continuous locally. IN/OUT bypass, ILM/DVDT routing and RPW land/paste reviewed. Thermal and hot-plug behavior remain measured qualifications, not established by DRC.
physical_and_exports.pump_fit: Maximum pump-head courtyard separation remains5.075mm, but nearby C34/body clearance is tight (~0.22mm conservative rectangular bound); actual pump head, hoses, wiring and capacitors require physical dry-fit. No shown footprint overlap.

electrical_assessment.input: J2→F1→D1→VIN_RAW→TPS259472ARPWR→VIN. U12 pins/programming match TI. UVLO nominal9.36V rising/8.502V falling at raw node; jack threshold includes D1 drop. 1.65k gives~2.03A nominal, conservative~1.78–2.22A. 390k selects13.8V clamp; typical3.3nF slew gives~18ms start. These values do not prove dynamic protection or allow24V operation.
electrical_assessment.bypass: C65 1uF50V0805 plusC66 100nF at raw input; C67 correct4.7uF50V1206 CC1206KKX7R9BB475 at output. Prior primary typical DC-bias assessment gives C67~2.1uF at12V/~1.8uF at14.6V, not guaranteed minima; selected value resolves prior too-small local output bypass concern.
electrical_assessment.rails: TPS563203 nominal outputs4.52V,6.00V,3.30V from196k/30k,270k/30k,135k/30k. Revised22uF electrolytics retain two22uF ceramics on each motor rail.88.3uF nominal and105.93uF simple positive-tolerance total are below110uF recommended max; load response/stability and ripple life require bench checks.
electrical_assessment.drivers: AO3400A source grounded, gate via100ohm with10k pulldown, drain to load negative; four flybacks cathode to positive rail/anode to drain. Pump1=U7LED0/Q3/U8,pump2=LED1/Q4/U11; valve1=U4P0/Q10/U10,valve2=P1/Q8/U9.
electrical_assessment.host: J18 pins1GND,2SDA,3SCL; four-wire peripheral ports carry board3.3V output. Default addressesPCA9685=0x40,TCA9534A=0x3F,MPR=0x18. ExternalTCA9548A at0x71, one board per selected channel, coherent with accepted requirements. Use one-hot channel selection/STOP, upstream pullups, initialization before outputs. Preserve intentional keep-last state; test resulting brownout recovery.

remaining_qualification: Exact regulated12V adapter rating/model, wiring voltage drop, simultaneous load budget and pump stall/valve current remain unmeasured.
Scope raw/protected input and4.5/6/3.3V rails during hot-plug, cold start, simultaneous pump/valve actuation, PWM and brownout with retained state. Verify transients below IC limits.
Measure eFuse, D1, MOSFET, regulators/inductors and capacitors under intended intermittent duty and overload/retry. Clamping dissipates far more than normal~0.112W eFuse loss at2A.
Dry-fit actual pumps/hoses/connectors and polarized capacitors. Confirm harness polarity, actual purchased parts, vendor placement rotations and U12 paste/stencil approval.

Exercise actual mux/controller firmware, startup output states and cable rise times. TCA9534 output latch should be cleared before changing valve pins to outputs; PCA wake delay required. User accepts keep-last behavior; this is not an added watchdog requirement.
